links.outcome: AUROC of AI early warning versus MEWS/NEWS for IHCA or unplanned ICU transfer
links.effect: Composite outcome AUROC for DeepCARS 0.869 vs 0.756 (MEWS) and 0.767 (NEWS); fewer alarms per 1,000 beds at same sensitivity and higher rate of appropriate alarms.
links.quote: In terms of the composite outcome, the AUROC for the DeepCARS™ was superior to those for the MEWS and NEWS (0.869 vs. 0.756/0.767).

links.outcome: Prospective performance of predictive model on live production data
links.effect: Prospective multicenter evaluation in real-world practice showed DeepCARS AUROC 0.869, superior to MEWS/NEWS, indicating retrospective performance was retained prospectively.
links.quote: This prospective study aimed to investigate the predictive accuracy of the DeepCARS™ for IHCA or unplanned intensive care unit transfer (UIT) among general ward patients, compared with that of conventional methods in real-world practice.

screen.reason: Prospective multicenter cohort validation of a commercial/developed deep-learning risk prediction tool (DeepCARS) in real-world clinical practice evaluating model discrimination and alarm burden, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational strategy.
